export interface IconProps {
  name: IconName;
  className?: string;
  "aria-hidden"?: boolean | "true" | "false";
  "aria-label"?: string;
}

export function Icon({
  name,
  className,
  "aria-hidden": ariaHidden,
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
}: IconProps) {
  return (
    <HugeiconsIcon
      icon={ICON_MAP[name]}
      className={cn(className)}
      aria-hidden={ariaHidden}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      data-icon={name}
    />
  );
}
